Fantastic lunch and wonderful service from Anna!
Sep 2026 • Couples
My wife and I had a fantastic lunch at Lake View 1983. The drinks and spring rolls were excellent, and we really enjoyed both the beef salad and the shrimp salad with mango.

A special thank-you to Anna, our fantastic English-speaking server. She was very helpful and knowledgeable, made ordering easy, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit.

Great food, fantastic drinks, and wonderful service. Highly recommended!

Great restaurant
Sep 2026 • Couples

We had Rice Sizzling Pancakes which Anna showed us how to east with rice pancakes. Delicious.

We had a great time at this lovely restaurant.
Thank you and thank you Anna.
